race.description: 2026 Psp Peak Of The Creek Heat 1
race.comment: ALWAYSBJOY NZ (4) is a handy filly who placed fresh then drew wide last start. Drops to the distance that has produced all five wins and she won her lone third-up attempt so could be ready to peak. BARRACUDA NZ (10) enjoyed a class drop at his latest appearance, leading as favourite and scoring by 1.1 metres. Not drawn the best so may need a 10/10 drive but he drops to a distance where he has won three of four tries and he is building a strong record here. SON OF XENA (9) has been solid in finishing top-four in his three outings since he came from this row for a win at this circuit and distance. With even luck he has strong claims. FICTION FILE (3) has switched from Victoria since she ended last prep with a win at Geelong four-and-a-half months ago. Draws well so is capable of a forward showing while fresh.
